name: Pitch deck
description: A venture pitch with a clear promise, product demonstration, evidence, market logic and a concrete ask. Fourteen adaptable slides with oversized statements, generous visual frames and precise comparisons.
structure: A purpose-led opening and a memorable closing vision frame the investor story.
Customer pain, solution and product demonstration have different compositions.
Traction, market and financial positions use clearly labeled evidence placeholders, never invented numbers.
Commercial logic includes business model, route to customers and realistic alternatives.
Founder portraits and a milestone-based funding ask connect capability with the next stage.
Every slide and its editable placeholder content is copied into the new instance.
Shorten or reorder the skeleton for stage, audience and duration; use 5–7 key ideas for a short Demo Day pitch.
